CCXT 4.5.85
https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt
Unmodified official browser build from the pinned npm package.
MIT license; see LICENSE.txt and ccxt.browser.min.js.LICENSE.txt.
UPIC enables Kraken, Coinbase Exchange and Binance spot public feeds.
Loaded on demand in a Web Worker. No credentials or order methods are used.
Reproduce: npm ci --ignore-scripts && node scripts/build-ccxt.mjs
